explanations: get() treats a replica that failed to answer as one that answered "no value" and counts it toward R. With a down, the read finishes as soon as a and the stale replica c have "answered", so it never waits for b, the replica that actually has the latest write. The W + R > N overlap guarantee only holds when R real answers are counted. With two replicas down the read returns null, and the registry turns that into factory firmware. The fix counts only successful replies toward R and rejects with QuorumError once fewer than R replicas can still answer, the same way put() handles W.
